title: Radio: FSDO Notified — UAS-11 Unauthorized Flight

lines.text: This is the ASO. I have just reported to the FAA FSDO via HUOG-ERP Section 6.2. Incident: unauthorized command injection, C2 link compromise, and flight outside authorized parameters. UAS-11 flew over the lodge patio, which is prohibited during guest events. Site Survey Form (FOM-3) for Birch Hollow Range does not list the van. FSDO is now in the loop.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged female, calm but urgent, slight pause between sentences

instructorNote: This inject confirms the FSDO has been notified per HUOG-ERP Section 6 and HUOG-ISP Section 9.1. The IC must ensure no flight data is released until FSDO review is complete.
